contentPattern.structure: repeating items: label | link; last item is current page (no link)

suitableFor: breadcrumb path trails on interior pages

implementationNote: Block-based component (resourceType block/v1/block) with repeating breadcrumb-item children (label + aem-content link). Source page has no breadcrumb markup — it is an authored trail. Named breadcrumb (not columns-*) so md2jcr keeps the variant class.
